name: Toolscreen 1.0.5
body:
Setup video: https://youtu.be/YqS-fxPx_jo
Ko-fi for donations: https://ko-fi.com/jojoe77777

Patches in 1.0.5:
- Fixed a bug with color backgrounds in EyeZoom mode covering the middle section
- Fixed a bug with the EyeZoom FPS limit slider in settings
- Addressed potential flicker issues with EyeZoom clone

Changelog from 1.0.4:

## Installer
- Now prompts for permission to exclude itself in Windows Defender
## New Features
- Added a hotkey to toggle borderless mode
- Added a hotkey to toggle visibility of all image overlays, or all window overlays
- Added an option to not have measuring pixels on the whole EyeZoom overlay, just in the middle
- Supports rebinding mouse buttons & keys like Right Shift
## Changes
- Increased the range for sensitivity sliders to 0.001 <-> 10.0
- Made the "Press Ctrl+i" prompt in the top left fade out after 10 seconds
- Increased default font size & measuring overlay width for EyeZoom
- Added an FPS limit to the EyeZoom clone, defaulting to 60 fps
- Disable "Only on my screen" for mirrors due to potential cheating issues
- Added a hint about using Ctrl+Click in the GUI for slider input
- Fixed various performance issues (more improvements yet to come)
## Bug fixes
- Fixed "Reset to Defaults" in modes tab setting width & height of thin & wide to 1 pixel
- Fixed "Reset to Defaults" in mirrors tab not restoring mirror groups
- Fixed key binding where it said a key was being held down when it wasn't
- Fixed Window Overlays being missing from thin & wide modes
- Fixed mirror output size/position not reloading properly when set to a relative percentage
- Fixed custom theme colours not saving when restarting
- Fixed mode width & height changes not saving when edited in the Basic tab
- Fixed being able to drag window overlays after closing the config GUI
- Potential fix for custom fonts causing rendering issues with the config GUI
- Potential fix for a crash when editing config or using EyeZoom mode
- Other fixes for performance & flicker issues
